Coram : Sri Ananda Sen, J.
: Sri Subhash Chand, J.
-------
 For the Appellant : Mr. Anjani Kumar, Advocate
For the State : Mrs. Ruby Pandey, A.P.P.

For the Informant : Mr. Parambir Singh Bajaj, Advocate  --------
07 /14.03.2024 I.A. No.11073 of 2023 This interlocutory application has been filed by the appellant praying therein to suspend the sentence and release him on bail during pendency of this appeal.

2. The appellant has been convicted and sentenced in connection with Spl. (POCSO) No. 34 of 2021 for the offence under Section 363 and 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
He has been sentenced to undergo RI for 25 years amongst other sentences.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the appellant, learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the informant and have gone through the impugned judgment, the evidence and the Trial Court Records.
4.
Opportunity was given to the State to oppose the bail, which the State availed and opposed.
5. Learned counsel for the informant also opposes for bail.

6. From the evidence of P.W.-1 (the victim), we find that in her deposition she states that as per the admit card her date of birth is 23.10.2005 but she further states that her Aadhar Card was prepared and as per Aadhar Card her year of birth is 2002.
The occurrence had taken place on 20.03.2021.
She states that she was taken by this appellant to Gujarat, where they stayed for 10-11 days and forceful physical relationship was developed by this appellant.

Further, she stated that she was taken to Musabani, where they resided in the maternal uncle's house of this appellant and she alleges that Suraj Patro vs The State Of Jharkhand on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181943371/
1 there also forceful physical relationship was established by the appellant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thereafter, they were recovered by the police from Musabani.
7. From the aforesaid fact, it is quite clear that the girl was travelling with this appellant to Gujarat and, thereafter, to Musabani but she did not raise any alarm at that time.

8. Considering the aforesaid fact, upon suspending the sentence, the appellant, namely, Suraj Patro is directed to be released on bail during the pendency of this appeal, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge (POCSO), East Singhbhum at Jamshedpur in connection with Spl.
(POCSO) No. 34 of 2021, subject to condition that the appellant will mark his attendance once in every four months before the Registrar, Civil Court, East Singhbhum at Jamshedpur till disposal of this appeal.

entities.text: Special Judge (POCSO), East Singhbhum at Jamshedpur
